chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Jamīl ibn Darrāj or Jamīl ibn Ṣāliḥ, from al-Fuḍayl ibn Yasār, who said:
I asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a newborn who has neither what belongs to males nor what belongs to females. He said:
For this one, the Imam casts lots. He writes on one lot: ʿAbd Allāh, and writes on another lot: Amat Allāh. Then the Imam, or the one drawing the lots, says:
O Allah, You are Allah; there is no god but You, Knower of the unseen and the seen. You judge between Your servants concerning that wherein they differ.

Clarify for us the matter of this newborn, so that the inheritance prescribed for this child in Your Book may be assigned. Then he places the two lots among indistinct lots, then they are mixed, and whichever of the two comes out, inheritance is assigned according to it.

key_terms.أَمَةَ ٱللَّهِ: the designation indicating female assignment on the lot
key_terms.سِهَامٍ مُبْهَمَةٍ: unmarked or indistinct lots mixed with the marked ones
key_terms.عَالِمَ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَ ٱلشَّهَادَةِ: Knower of the unseen and the seen
key_terms.عَبْدَ ٱللَّهِ: the designation indicating male assignment on the lot
key_terms.يُقْرِعُ: he casts lots to determine a ruling
key_terms.ٱلْإِمَامُ: the Imam as the authoritative judge in the matter

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام rule on inheritance for a newborn with ambiguous sex?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for a newborn whose sex cannot be determined by apparent physical characteristics. It instructs that the Imam should use lot-casting, accompanied by a du'a invoking Allah’s knowledge and judgment, so that the child’s inheritance may be assigned according to what Allah has prescribed in His Book.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5705 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Jameel ibn Darraj or Jameel ibn Salih from Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a newborn who has neither the characteristics of males nor females.
Imam (as) said: "

In this case, the Imam will cast lots. He will write on one lot 'Servant of Allah (swt)' (Abdullah) and on another lot 'Maidservant of Allah (swt)' (Amatullah).
Then the Imam or the one drawing the lots will say:
'O' Allah (swt), You are Allah (swt), there is no God but You (swt). Knower of the unseen and the seen, You (swt) judge between Your (swt) servants in what they differ.

Clarify for us the matter of this newborn so that we may allot the inheritance You (swt) have prescribed for them in Your (swt) Book'.
Then the two lots will be placed among other unidentified lots, and whichever one is drawn will determine how the child inherits."
